summary: Verified digest, allowed scope and controller results: 51 focused and 1011 total tests passed. Independent focused tests passed. R1, R3 and R4 are resolved; R2 remains partially unresolved. No implementation defect found.

issues.description: The message assertions here and at line 615 compare str(exc) with str(sent) after asserting exc is sent, so they cannot detect message mutation. Independent in-memory probes changed all six sentinel exceptions' args; every sentinel assertion still passed. Context preservation and patch restoration are now correctly guarded.
issues.required_change: In both exception-scenario loops, capture expected_message = str(sent) before invoking the API, then assert str(exc) == expected_message. Preserve the existing class, identity, context and patch-restoration checks.
issues.validation: All six scenarios must pass unchanged propagation and reject mutation of the original exception's message. Rerun both required controller checks after the fix.
